incidents.symptom: The first label-free runner invocation stopped before backend construction because the immutable safe-bank manifest has no path field.
incidents.diagnosis: The manifest intentionally preserves candidate_id and file_sha256; the runner incorrectly assumed a path field.
incidents.repair: Reconstruct the historical candidate path only as CANDIDATE_DIRECTIONS/<candidate_id>.npy and continue to verify the persisted file SHA-256.

incidents.symptom: The second label-free runner invocation stopped at the repository's remote-only HuggingFace guard because the Spark-1 execution profile variables were not exported.
incidents.diagnosis: The canonical Spark-1 venv and model were present, but CEG_EXECUTION_PROFILE and HF_HOME were unset in the non-interactive SSH environment.
incidents.repair: Use the documented Spark-1 profile with CEG_EXECUTION_PROFILE=SPARK1 and HF_HOME=/srv/shared/hf-cache for the rerun; no dependency, model, or code change is required.

incidents.symptom: The third label-free runner invocation loaded the frozen model and then stopped because the inherited M1/M2 manifests store prompts in prompt_provenance rather than a top-level prompt field.
incidents.diagnosis: The runner used an invalid manifest schema assumption. No layer capture or A1/A2 array was written.
incidents.repair: Reconstruct the prompt with canonical_q2_v3_task_prompt(code, input) and verify the frozen raw prompt-bytes SHA-256 before creating an ExternalItem.
